mapper.select: SELECT id, wkt, type, feature FROM data_geomorphological WHERE ST_Contains( geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}::double precision, #{lat}::double precision), 4326) ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( ST_Centroid(geom)::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}::double precision, #{lat}::double precision), 4326)::geography ) ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
